_meta.purpose: Made-up Quick Quiz submissions for tests and demo pages. Not real clients. Names, emails (example.com), phone numbers (555-01xx) and street addresses are fictional.
_meta.answers: Keys are question ids from questions.json. Pick-one questions take an option id, pick-several questions take a list of option ids, text questions take text. A missing question means it was skipped.
_meta.note: Each sample's 'note' says who it is meant to represent, so a reviewer can check the brief against the intent.

samples.note: Clear Decisive Delegator. Strong fit: renovation, $150K-$400K, ready in 3-6 months, full service, in Burnaby. Finished fast with short answers.
Clear Analytical Validator. Strong fit: new build over $400K in Vancouver, 6-12 months out. Took their time and wrote a long, detailed answer.

answers.home_meaning: Home is where everything has a reason to be where it is. We want a house that performs well for decades: good air quality, low energy bills, materials that age well, and a layout we have actually thought through rather than inherited. We have read a lot about Passive House and want to understand the trade-offs.
